---
title: Crostini with Provatura and Anchovies
id: MAR-0030
lang: en
source_lang: it
servings: 4
time_min: 30
difficulty: medium
---
## Ingredients
- 8 slices of country bread
- 300 g of provatura
- 2 salted anchovies
- 80 g of butter
- to taste black pepper
## Method
1. Cut from the cheese and bread discs about 2 cm high; thread them alternately on skewers, making sure the cheese adheres well to the bread.
2. Place the skewers in a pan, resting the ends on the edges, keeping them suspended.
3. Cook them in the oven at 200 °C for about 10 minutes.
4. Desalt the anchovies and melt them in the butter, stirring with a wooden spoon.
5. Pour the anchovy butter over the skewers, season with pepper, and serve.
